inherited_mathematical_inputs: D120/D121: the positive k-th original child column is divisible by pi^k; fixed-mass contraction and integral low inverse.
D121: refined transport parameters at P=10552 and the CM truncation/kernel-error proof.
D121/D122: actual P=400 harmonic and CM banks, P=400 r=32 factor, exact masses and original branches.
D122: independent integer quotient arithmetic in source 486; all curve comparison bounds remain unchanged.
For fixed masses, T maps I_P={e:e_0=0, v_pi(e_k)>=max(0,P-k)} to pi^P in every output row.
If Tz-z belongs to I_P, then y=Tz has uniform original residual zero modulo pi^P.
Moment k, field coordinate i needs max(0,ceil((P-k-i)/8)) binary digits in weighted storage.
After eliminating r low moments, a high residual of valuation u needs only k<P-u; the next band ends at P-u-r-1.
Stop the weighted correction stage when u+r+1>=P, then reconstruct; this does not label weighted centers uniformly accurate.
Composing g=(Ax+B)/(1+Cx), C in pi O, with each original contracting child f preserves c and determinant divisibility by pi; the normalizing denominator 1+C*b is a unit.

Therefore direct CM moments can be calculated uniformly modulo pi^P from weighted state precision P-k, using P input moments without the 3P state extension. All 34 compositions are checked in separate integer quotient arithmetic.
The existing carry-free GMP packing proof applies to the new C small-product implementation; no new external theorem is used.
new_deductions: With exact masses, positive input columns are pi-divisible. If the original finite residual vanishes modulo pi^P, the error e satisfies e=T_+ e modulo pi^P, hence e=0 after P iterations. Correctness of the final moment state does not depend on the seed or intermediate iteration payloads.

A prospective rolling scratch protocol can bound intermediate storage without weakening that final certificate, provided the original full residual, exact masses, transport/truncation assumptions, final state and required checks are preserved. This protocol has not yet been implemented.

comparison_certificates.method: integer quotient absolute-error balls, frame residual bounds, gradients and polar forms

decision: Retain the candidate as compatible with the independently reviewed P800 comparison. Finite zero-containing balls do not prove exact vanishing.
